pages.title: Producer Skills
pages.text: Add crafting effects to the producer active skills. The result keeps its modifiers when given to someone else. Common item and item_tag filters restrict outputs; chance is the success probability and benefits from mastery:proc_chance.

pages.title: Crafted Attributes
pages.text: mastery:crafting_attribute adds a persistent attribute modifier. Choose attribute, amount, operation, and slot. For a sword, minecraft:generic.attack_damage with slot mainhand adds damage while held. amount scales with active skill rank.

pages.title: Crafted Food
pages.text: mastery:crafting_food can increase nutrition_bonus and saturation_bonus. Fractional values are percentage increases per rank: 0.25 means +25%. buff_strength_bonus and buff_duration_bonus alter built-in food effects.

pages.title: Crafted Potions
pages.text: mastery:crafting_potion uses amplifier_bonus for additional strength tiers and duration_bonus for a duration fraction. added_effect can append a specific mob effect with added_duration and added_amplifier. Time fields use ticks.

pages.title: Optional Meal Bonuses
pages.text: meal_strength_bonus and meal_duration_bonus affect Needs Not Necessities meal buffs when that mod is present. Mastery does not require Needs Not Necessities. Its absence leaves ordinary crafting bonuses available.

pages.title: Placement Comfort
pages.text: mastery:placed_comfort grants additional comfort for blocks the skilled player places. Set amount, radius, comfort_type, and optional block or block_tag filters. Needs Not Necessities reads the extra provider only when installed.

pages.title: Check Your Machine
pages.text: Ordinary player crafting and other supported player-owned production paths can identify the producer. Automated machines without a player cannot infer whose skills to use. Check the resulting item and production path in your pack.
